name: Inverse Transforming Spheres
aliases: Inverse Quaternion Möbius Transform for Spheres
definition: Method to find coefficients of the original sphere given coefficients of a transformed sphere, allowing transformation of world-space spheres to kernel space.
summary: Inverse Transforming Spheres computes kernel-space sphere coefficients from world-space inputs via algebraic expansion, avoiding iterative root-finding to enable standard ray-sphere intersection testing.
